overview.description: The Porter & Company Property & Casualty Index ETF (PCPC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Porter & Co. P&C Insurance index. The Porter & Company Property & Casualty Index ETF (the Fund) seeks to track the investment results, before fees and expenses, of the Porter & Co. P&C Insurance Index (the P&C Insurance Index). PCPC was launched on Sep 15, 2026 and is issued by Porter & Company.
